subject: English
stimulus: (a) The students are studying hard lest ⎯⎯. (b) There is a popular saying ⎯⎯. (c) Our life is meaningless until ⎯⎯. (d) It matters little to me whether ⎯⎯. (e) Hardly had he started for school ⎯⎯.
guide_solution: Completing sentences (a) The students are studying hard lest they should fail to achieve expected grades. (b) There is a popular saying that industry is the key to success. (c) Our life is meaningless untill we understand the evils of laziness. (d) It matters little to me whether he comes or not. (e) Hardly had he started for school when the guests came.
